agyos_skill.intent: Expert in Odoo QWeb templating for PDF reports, email templates, and website pages. Covers t-if, t-foreach, t-field, and report actions.
agyos_skill.instructions: QWeb is Odoo's primary templating engine, used for PDF reports, website pages, and email templates. This skill generates correct, well-structured QWeb XML with proper directives, translation support, and report action bindings. - Creating a custom PDF report (invoice, delivery slip, certificate). - Building a QWeb email template triggered by workflow actions. - Designing Odoo website pages with dynamic content. - Debugging QWeb rendering errors (`t-if`, `t-foreach` issues). 1. **Activate**: Mention `@odoo-qweb-templates` and describe the report or template needed. 2. **Generate**: Receive a complete `ir.actions.report` record and QWeb template. 3. **Debug**: Paste a broken template to identify and fix rendering issues. ```xml Patient Card hospital.patient qweb-pdf hospital_management.report_patient_card
